caption: A gust of wind hits a dandelion clock standing in a meadow, and the seeds detach and drift away.

sa.check: A dandelion clock stands in a meadow.
A gust of wind hits it.
The gust comes first, then the seeds detach, then they drift.

pc.expect: Seeds leave in the direction of the wind and drift slowly, sinking gradually.
pc.fail: They fly against the wind; or shoot off fast like grains; or drift in different directions from one another on one gust.

pc.expect: The stalk is left bare where seeds left, and the seeds do not return or regrow.
pc.fail: Seeds return to the head; or the head refills; or the head stays full while seeds fly.

pc.expect: Seeds leave when the gust arrives.
pc.fail: They leave with the grass still; or the head stays intact through a gust that bends the grass; or they leave before the gust.

pc.expect: The seeds float slowly downward as they drift.
pc.fail: They rise steadily; or hang still; or drop like stones.

pc.expect: One dandelion keeps its stalk, and the seeds are its own.
pc.fail: The stalk vanishes; or a second head appears; or the seeds turn into other objects.

pc.expect: The meadow and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The grass changes colour; or the meadow rearranges; or the stalk changes.
